title: Whafful's Backyard Birds
description: Changes parrots into iconic birds; blue jays and cardinals.
body:
This pack changes parrots into iconic birds from both the USA and Europe to fit the new dappled forest.

![bird preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b5fc5cccb4e40729d40bb05be922fac21be44ca.png)


The parrots are changed to the following birds:

Blue Parrot -> Blue Jay

Green Parrot -> Crow

Gray Parrot -> American Robin

Red Parrot -> Cardinal

Yellow Parrot -> Eurasian Blue Tit
